mentions.name: throwdown.top
mentions.description: A free web app for creating leaderboards for club CrossFit competitions. It offers a simple set of forms and tables without feature overload, with an emphasis on comfortable UX, and has been battle-tested at real club events.
mentions.audience: CrossFit box owners and club competition organizers
mentions.source_excerpt: Building throwdown.top: a free web app for making leaderboards for club crossfit competitions. The main goal was to build a tool for a friend who owns a crossfit box.
mentions.author: cookienaut
